long_biography.plain_text:
Perfetti is the son of Ambrogio Perfetti and nephew of Egidio Perfetti, the brothers who built an Italian confectionery business after the Second World War. He and his brother Giorgio inherited control after the founders died. Augusto later served as chairman, making him more than a passive recipient during a pivotal stage in the company's development.

As chairman of Perfetti, he led the 2001 purchase of Dutch confectioner Van Melle, whose brands included Mentos and Fruit-tella. The combination created Perfetti Van Melle and broadened the family's international reach; the group subsequently acquired Chupa Chups. Augusto no longer holds an operating post, while professional executives and another family member oversee the company he still co-owns with Giorgio.
